Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players stride out to the middle. Ben McDermott and Aaron Finch , oh wait! It is Ashton Agar who gets an opportunity to showcase his ability. So, it will be him and Ben McDermott to open the innings for Australia. Sri Lanka start with spin as Maheesh Theekshana has the ball in hand.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! Australia have done a fantastic job and would bank on their batters to chase 122. Sri Lanka will need something really special to make a match out of this and stay alive in the series. Stay tuned to see how the chase unfolds.

Australia had a great start as Kane Richardson struck twice in the third over to put the visitors in early trouble. They maintained that pressure as after the Powerplay, the spinners joined the party and Ashton Agar and Glenn Maxwell got wickets in successive overs. The bowlers never allowed them to settle and kept the run flow in check. It was an outstanding bowling display from the Aussies, especially from Kane Richardson who ended with 3/21.

Sri Lanka needed their batters to step up but in trying to show intent upfront, they lost two wickets inside the Powerplay. Kusal Mendis also failed to perform coming back into the side while their man-in-form, Pathum Nissanka also couldn't do much damage and got out and that dug a deep hole fairly early on for the Lankans. Dinesh Chandimal and Dasun Shanaka added 47 runs for the fifth wicket but could not up the ante. Dasun Shanaka stayed in the end for his side but could never launch and the side have ended up with just 121 on the board.

Sri Lanka struggled to get their innings going. They were put into early trouble from which they could never recover and have ended up with a below-par total. On the other hand, Australia were sensational with the ball and would be proud of their performance.
Full and straight, Dushmantha Chameera drives it through mid on for a single. Another finish by Josh Hazlewood and Sri Lanka finish with 121/6!
FOUR! Full and straight, Dushmantha Chameera clears the front leg and thumps it right back over the bowler's head for a boundary. Sri Lanka do manage to get to the 120 run mark.
Slower one, banged into the pitch and around off. Shanaka can only manage to scoop it over Josh Hazlewood for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Josh Hazlewood's consistency continues with the ball as he picks up his first wicket of the night. A length ball, angled into off. It is there to be hit but Chamika Karunaratne once again hangs deep and looks to muscle it leg side. The ball comes off the splice of the bat and skies up towards the cover region. Josh Inglis runs behind to his left and takes a comfortable catch. Dushmantha Chameera walks out to bat.
Commentary.Howout: c Josh Inglis b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Top shot! Hazlewood misses the yorker on off stump. Chamika Karunaratne hangs deep in his crease and squeezes it through extra cover for a boundary.
Excellent delivery! Almost a yorker, outside off. Karunaratne attempts another cross-batted shot but misses.
Josh Hazlewood (3-0-21-0) to bowl the final over.
FOUR! Muscled! Short of a length, on off. Dasun Shanaka flat-bats it right back over the umpire's head and into the fence. 11 off the over.
Full, on off. This is pushed back past the bowler towards long off for another couple of runs.

In the air...safe! A length ball, outside off. Dasun Shanaka stands tall and looks to lift it over the long off fence but gets it off the toe end of the bat. The ball falls safely around the long on region. Two taken.

The on air commentator says that this delivery is the 55th dot ball of this innings. Well, that's a staggering amount of dot balls. Full and wide, Shanka tries to get funky and looks to lap it from outside off. The ball sneaks in between bat and pad and goes through to the keeper.
Swing and a miss! Slower one, pushed a bit wider. Shanaka backs away looking to go over cover but misses.
Full and wide, Karunaratne shuffles across yet again and nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Karunaratne shuffles across the off stump. Starc fires it in at the leg stump. Karunaratne manages to get enough bat on it to work it on the leg side for a single.
No harm done! On middle, this is heaved away to deep mid-wicket for a single.

NO BALL AND FOUR! Oh my God! Have you ever seen anything like that? Mitchell Starc attempts the off cutter from over the wicket but gets it completely wrong. The ball spills out of his hand and curves away around head high and meters away from the tramline line. The ball then runs away into the third man fence. Free hit coming up...
Full and on the pads. Clipped away behind square on the leg side for one.
Karunaratne pre-meditates and moves outside off. Starc angles in a short ball from 'round the wicket and Karunaratne can do nothing about it.
Starc switches to over the wicket and nails the yorker on middle and leg. Shanaka jams it out to long on for a single.
FOUR! Geez, that's a good shot. Starc misses the yorker on off. Dasun Shanaka makes room and transfers his weight well onto the front to hit it inside-out, over extra cover for a wonderful boundary.

Lovely drive just for a single. Full, on off. Dasun Shanaka drives it cleanly towards mid off. Josh Hazlewood picks up the ball and has a pop at the bowler's end but misses the target. Shanaka was a goner if that had hit. Just two runs and a wicket off that over.
On off, this is punched towards extra cover for a single.
Change of bats for Chamika Karunaratne.
Banged in short at around 136 kph, over off. Karunaratne looks to pull but only manages to find the fielder at mid-wicket.
And again! Around the top of off, Karunaratne cannot get it through the leg side.
On a good length, angled into middle. Chamika Karunaratne keeps it out on the leg side.
The new batter in is Chamika Karunaratne.

OUT! Cleaned up! Kane Richardson is having a ball out there! Richardson comes back into the attack and straightaway breaks the partnership. Seam up, full and right at the base of the off pole. Dinesh Chandimal clears his front leg and looks to heave it leg side but ends up playing all around a straight delivery. The ball hits the off stump on the full and just when Chandimal was starting to click, he perishes.
Kane Richardson (2-0-10-2) comes back into the attack.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries now! Another really slower delivery, banged in down the leg side. Dasun Shanaka has to wait an age for it to arrive but does well to get a tickle on it. The ball runs away past the keeper and into the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Full and wide, Shanaka hangs deep in his crease and slices this one into the point fence. A much needed boundary for Sri Lanka.
This is banged into the surface, around off. Chandimal pulls it aerially in front of square for a single.
Shanaka makes up his mind to scoop this one and Sama pushes it really wide. In the end, Shanaka can only manage to maneuver it to deep square leg for a run.
Nicely done! Slower delivery, very full and close to the off pole. Dasun Shanaka makes room but gets undone by the lack of pace on the ball.
Fullish delivery, on the pads. Chandimal looks to work it behind square on the leg side but gets an inside edge down to short fine leg for a run.
Daniel Sams (2-0-7-0) is back on.
FOUR! A boundary after 35 balls! Much-needed for Sri Lanka! Length ball, on off. Dasun Shanaka this time manages to scoop it to fine leg for a boundary.
Well bowled! Dasun Shanaka moves to the off side early and Josh Hazlewood sees that. He bowls it short and on off, Dasun Shanaka tries to scoop it over the keeper but misses.
Short of a length, on middle. Dinesh Chandimal pulls it to deep square leg. There is a fielder stationed there and will only get a single.
Swing and a miss! Back of a length, outside off. Dinesh Chandimal went for the pull but fails to connect.
Outside off, on a length. Dinesh Chandimal throws the kitchen sink at it. The ball was in the air for sometime but it lands safe towards sweeper cover. The batter gets a couple of runs.
On a good length, outside off. Dinesh Chandimal steps out and jabs it to the off side.
On the pads, Chandimal just flicks it past square leg to make it a fourth single in a row.
This is angled in from around off. Shanaka strokes it through cover-point for a run.
Quicker one, fired in outside off. Chandimal taps it towards point for a single.
On middle, Shanaka pushes it back past the bowler for a run.

There is a bit of grip in the surface. On off, Shanaka looks to turn it through mid-wicket but the ball just doesn't come on and the leading edge is found. The ball tickles away towards short third man.
Quicker and shorter, on middle. Chandimal eases it down to long on for a single.

NOT OUT! Flatter ball, down the leg side. Dinesh Chandimal gets down on one knee and looks to sweep but misses. Matthew Wade collects the ball and whips the bails off. He is interested and appeals for stumping. The umpire signals it as wide and takes it upstairs. The third umpire checks for caught behind as well. There is nothing on UltraEdge. Replay shows that Dinesh Chandimal's feet were inside the crease. So, it will be just wide then!

Is that a stumping? Matthew Wade seems really interested. The caught behind will also be checked and UltraEdge shows that there's no bat involved. On the first side-on replay, it seems close but Dinesh Chandimal has a bit of his back foot inside the crease. The third umpire confirms the same and it's NOT OUT!
Full and slower, on off. Dasun Shanaka makes room and drives it to cover.
Back of a length, on leg. Dasun Shanaka tries to pull but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Outside off, on a length. Dinesh Chandimal has an ugly heave at that one. The ball goes off the outside edge to third man for a single.

Short and on middle, Dinesh Chandimal pulls it to deep square leg. Josh Hazlewood from deep backward square leg runs to his left while Ben McDermott from deep mid-wicket is also charging for the ball. He puts in a dive but fails to stop. Josh Hazlewood then did well to flick the ball back in. Two runs taken.
Slower delivery, on the pads. Dasun Shanaka tickles it to fine leg for a run.
Short of a length, on leg. Pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Daniel Sams (1-0-2-0) is brought back into the attack.
Just short! Tosses it up nicely, outside off, turning away. Dasun Shanaka steps out and gets a leading edge to short cover. Aaron Finch dives forward but the ball falls just short of him.
On the pads, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
Flighted ball, full and on middle. Dasun Shanaka clears his front leg and pushes it to long on for a single.
Loopy ball, on middle. Dasun Shanaka misses his nudge. He gets hit on the thigh pad.
Floats it up, on off. Pushed to the covers for a single.
Flatter ball, angling in, on middle. Dinesh Chandimal prods and keeps it out.
Fuller in length, outside off. Dasun Shanaka hits it hard but straight into the hands of Aaron Finch at extra cover.
Slower ball, outside off. Kane Richardson guides it through backward point and rotates the strike.
Good-length ball, on middle. Dasun Shanaka flicks it to backward square leg. He crosses ends.
On a length, on off. Dinesh Chandimal steers it down to third man for one.
Good-length ball, outside off. Dinesh Chandimal pushes it straight to point.
On a length, outside off. Dasun Shanaka works it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter this time, on middle. Dasun Shanaka turns it through square leg for a run. Just the three singles off it.
A tad bit short, on off. Dinesh Chandimal jabs it down to long off for one more.
On middle, this is worked away to mid-wicket.
Quicker and darted into off. Dasun Shanaka hangs deep and chops it towards sweeper cover for a single.
On a nagging length, around off. Shanaka stays solid in defense.
Nicely flighted, outside off. Shanaka takes a couple of steps forward and defends it out.
FOUR! Finds the gap perfectly does Chandimal. Around the hips, this is whipped away behind square on the leg side for a welcome boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Chandimal looks to cut it off the back foot but only manages to get a bottom edge on it.
Full, around middle. This is pushed down towards long on for a single.
Shorter delivery, around off and this has a bit of pace behind it. Dasun Shanaka looks to slash it over short third man but doesn't connect.
Back of a length, angling across the right-hander. Chandimal guides it through backward point for one.
A length ball, around leg. Chandimal stands tall and drills it back towards the bowler. Mitchell Starc with good reflexes gets down low in time to make the stop.
Tries to get funky here does Shanaka. On off, Shanaka gets inside the line of the ball to scoop but misses and gets hit on the body.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Shanaka keeps it out.
Full and straight, Chandimal drills it down to long on for a run.
Cheeky! Around off, Dasun Shanaka gets inside the line of the ball and paddles it towards short fine leg for a single.
Dasun Shanaka walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Daniel Sams with a brilliant piece of fielding and the dangerman Pathum Nissanka departs. Tosed up, around middle. Nissanka gets in a good position to sweep and does so well. But the ball goes aerially towards the square leg fence. Sams moves swiftly to his right from the mid-wicket fence and puts in the dive to take a two-handed stunner. He knew exactly where the rope was and Glenn Maxwell has a wicket in his first over.
Commentary.Howout: c Daniel Sams b Glenn Maxwell

Commentary.Commentary: Angled across off, Chandimal drives it through cover-point for a single.
Shorter and quicker, outside off. Nissanka looks to cut it off the back foot but gets a bottom edge back onto the turf.
Tossed up, around off. Chandimal leans in and strokes it through covers for one.
Angled into middle and leg. Chandimal presses forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Dinesh Chandimal is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Really soft dismissal and Kusal Mendis will be thoroughly disappointed here. This is tossed up, on a length and around off. The ball holds a bit in the surface as well. Mendis with a nothing shot as he looks to work it leg side but closes the face of the bat way too early. The ball loops up off the leading edge and Ashton Agar has an easy catch to take.
On middle, turned towards mid-wicket for a single.
Time for some spin now! Ashton Agar is brought into the attack.
A bit too high. Flatter one, darted into middle and leg. Nissanka looks to nudge it on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. Agar appeals but the umpire is unmoved.
A well-directed bumper, around leg. Mendis just looks to dangle his pace and get it over the keeper but misses. Sri Lanka are 37/2 at the end of the Powerplay.

Easy three in the end. A bit of width on offer and Nissanka just guides it through the point region. Daniel Sams chases it down and just pulls it back towards Kane Richardson who overruns it and the batters come back for the third.
Full, around leg and this is heaved straight to mid-wicket.
Shorter and a bit slower, well outside off. Nissanka hops and looks to uppercut it over backward point but gets undone by the lack of pace.
Length ball, around leg. This is angled across and Nissanka looks to flick it away. He misses and gets hit high on the pads.
FOUR! A fullish delivery, on off. Nissanka makes a bit of room leg side and thumps it right back past the bowler and past the fielder at mid on for a boundary.
Mitchell Starc (1-0-8-0) is back on.
Short of a length, outside off. Pathum Nissanka dabs it to third man for a run.
WIDE! Length ball down the leg side. Pathum Nissanka misses his tuck. Wided.
Short ball, on middle. Kusal Mendis pulls it to deep square leg again without any timing. The ball lands well short of the fielder though and a single is taken.
Length ball, on middle. Kusal Mendis heaves it through mid-wicket. There was no timing on that one but still gets two.
Length ball, on off. Kusal Mendis taps it to point.
On a length, on off. Kusal Mendis punches it to the off side.
Good-length ball, on middle, hurries onto the batter. Kusal Mendis went for the pull but got an inside edge near the box.
Slower delivery, on middle. Kusal Mendis pushes it to mid off and retains the strike.
Short ball, on leg. Kusal Mendis looks to pull but misses.
On a good length, outside off, nipping away. Kusal Mendis is defeated all ends up and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short of a length, on middle. Pathum Nissanka mistimes his pull to mid on for a single.
On a length, on leg. Pathum Nissanka tries to work it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Daniel Sams starts with a back-of-a-length ball, on middle. Pathum Nissanka stands on his toes and keeps it out.
Daniel Sams is into the attack now.
On a good length, outside off. Kusal Mendis leaves it for the keeper to collect. A successful first over for Kane Richardson. Two wickets and 6 runs from it.
Kusal Mendis is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Perfect comeback from Kane Richardson! On a good length, outside off, nipping away a bit. Charith Asalanka with no feet movement has a poke at it. The ball kisses the outside edge and Matthew Wade makes no mistake behind the stumps. Australia right on top!
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Wade b Kane Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! In the slot and punished! What a shot! On middle, Charith Asalanka picks the bones of that one and hammers it all the way over long on for a biggie. That made a cracking sound off the bat!
Back of a length, on middle. Charith Asalanka blocks it out.
Well bowled! Good-length ball, outside off, angling away. Charith Asalanka looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Charith Asalanka is in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Kane Richardson strikes on his first ball. Danushka Gunathilaka tries to take him on but perishes. Kane Richardson with a half-volley, on leg. Danushka Gunathilaka shuffles across and tries to scoop it over. The ball goes off the bottom half and straight into the hands of Josh Hazlewood at short fine leg. He takes the simplest of catches there and Danushka Gunathilaka has to depary early yet again.
Commentary.Howout: c Josh Hazlewood b Kane Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: An early change in the bowling. Kane Richardson comes in to replace Mitchell Starc.
Length ball, outside off. Pathum Nissanka chops it back to the keeper.
Back of a length, on off. Pathum Nissanka hops and taps it to point.
On a good length, outside off. Danushka Gunathilaka taps it to point for a run.
FOUR! Shot! Length ball, outside off. Danushka Gunathilaka this time smacks it over mid on for a boundary.

In the air.....but safe! Good-length ball, on middle. Danushka Gunathilaka tries to heave it across the line and ends up getting a top edge. The ball goes high up in the air towards the mid on region. The fielder there tracks back and puts in a dive but fails to get a hand on it. Two runs taken!
Danushka Gunathilaka gets off the mark straightaway! Length ball, outside off, angling away. Danushka Gunathilaka leans and drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Josh Hazlewood to share the new ball with Mitchell Starc.
Outside off, on a length. Pathum Nissanka drives it through covers. It came off the toe end of the bat but will still fetch a couple of runs. A decent first over from Mitchell Starc. 8 runs off it!

FOUR! Pathum Nissanka gets off the mark with a boundary! It is short again, outside off. Pathum Nissanka was ready for it. He picks it beautifully and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for the first boundary of the innings.
WIDE! Short of a length, down the leg side. Pathum Nissanka looks to pull it away but misses. Wide given.
A low full toss, on off, Pathum Nissanka drives it to mid on.
On a good length, pushed wider, Pathum Nissanka has a slash at it but fails to connect.
A full toss, outside off, shaping away. Pathum Nissanka leaves that one alone.
WIDE! Length ball sprayed down the leg side. Pathum Nissanka missed his flick. Wided. With this, Sri Lanka get underway!
Mitchell Starc starts with an inswinging yorker, on middle. Pathum Nissanka watches it closely, clears his front leg and squeezes it out.

We are ready for play! The Australian players are out in the middle and so are the Lankan openers, Pathum Nissanka and Danushka Gunathilaka. Mitchell Starc is ready to steam in with the new ball. Let's go...

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Danushka Gunathilaka, Pathum Nissanka, Charith Asalanka, Kusal Mendis (In place of Avishka Fernando), Dinesh Chandimal (WK), Dasun Shanaka (C), Chamika Karunaratne, Jeffrey Vandersay (In place of Wanindu Hasaranga), Dushmantha Chameera, Maheesh Theekshana, Nuwan Thushara.

Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), Ben McDermott, Josh Inglis, Glenn Maxwell, Marcus Stoinis, Matthew Wade (WK), Daniel Sams (In place of Steven Smith), Ashton Agar (In place of Adam Zampa), Mitchell Starc (In place of Pat Cummins), Kane Richardson, Josh Hazlewood.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and lands in the favor of Australia. They have elected to BOWL first.

Sri Lanka will take that last defeat with a grain of salt. They looked down and out but then the likes of Nissanka and the skipper, Shanaka made them believe. In the end, the tailenders almost got them over the line but it wasn't meant to be. Another big setback for the visitors is that marquee player Wanindu Hasaranga has tested positive for COVID-19 and will miss tonight's clash but Kusal Mendis is available for selection. So, will the Aussies seal the deal tonight? Or will Sri Lanka make them wait a little longer and make things interesting? We'll find out soon. Toss and team news in a bit.

Australia seemed to be set up for an easy win in the last match but little did they know that they would be pushed all the way. The Aussies will be thankful to Josh Hazlewood for getting them out of jail in the Super Over and he was brilliant throughout the match. Surprisingly the fielding was a huge let down for the hosts last time around and they would want to better that aspect tonight.

Hello and a warm welcome to the third T20I between Australia and Sri Lanka live from Canberra. A match that holds significant importance in terms of the series as the Aussies could seal the series right tonight and tinker with their side for the next couple of matches. The Lankans on the other hand need to win this match in order to stay alive in the series.
... MATCH DAY ...
